items.quote: Timeline - cannot be 🐎soon! It should be an exact date or sequence of events.
items.statement: Timeline should be an exact date or sequence of events.

items.quote: Motivation - cannot be 💵. It should be the actual reasons for a client to need money!
items.statement: Motivation should not be monetary but actual reasons for needing money.

overview: A note discussing the distinction between timeline and motivation in client interactions.
